messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to pull that data directly from an external source right now. However, I can give you a quick rundown of Canada’s public holidays in 2023 that typically create long weekends:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|
| Jan 1 (Tue) | New Year’s Day | Tue | No |
| Feb 20 (Mon) | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK) | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Mar 17 (Fri) | St. Patrick’s Day (NS) | Fri | No |
| Apr 7 (Thu) | Good Friday | Thu | Yes (Thu‑Sun) |
| Apr 10 (Sun) | Easter Monday (NL, PE) | Sun | Yes (Sat‑Mon) |
| May 22 (Mon) | Victoria Day | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Jul 1 (Sat) | Canada Day | Sat | Yes (Fri‑Sun) |
| Aug 7 (Mon) | Civic Holiday (BC, NB, NL, PE, QC) | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Sep 18 (Mon) | Labour Day | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Oct 9 (Mon) | Thanksgiving (NL, PE) | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Nov 2 (Mon) | Remembrance Day (NL, PE) | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Dec 25 (Mon) | Christmas Day | Mon | Yes (Mon‑Wed) |
| Dec 26 (Tue) | Boxing Day | Tue | No |

These dates are based on the federal statutory holidays and provincial variations. If you need a more detailed or province‑specific list, let me know!
